text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan takes 1st!! Crowned champion 
of the Triple Crown's first leg, it's 
Tosen Jordan!!
(Woooooaaaaahhh!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... that girl is insane...! I had no 
idea someone like her was here...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
The Triple Crown route is getting so 
heated...! There are tons of seriously 
interesting girls out there...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hah... Woah. That's hilarious. Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, I got 1st place in the Satsuki Sho!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, whoa. What's with that face? 
You're panicking way too much. Be more 
hyped!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh? My leg...?

Her blood was seeping through the tip of 
Tosen Jordan's shoe.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Whoa. Yikes...

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
“—Speaking as the one who examined you 
before, getting off this lightly is 
nothing short of a miracle.”

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
The first aid provided before arriving 
here and the preventative taping must have 
paid off. However...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hey, Teach.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"If I get this treated properly, how long 
is it gonna take?"

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
It seems to have become a recurring issue 
after cracking so many times. If we are 
aiming for a full recovery, we will need 
to deal with it quite patiently.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Just a moment ago, I ran the 
Satsuki Sho and clashed with my peers, 
didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Didn't that really feel like a beginning? 
Like I can totally do this too.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: That's why... in that case...!
choice_data_list: Did that make you want to race more?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"To run in the Classics, in the 'Satsuki 
Sho'. ...I thought just that would be 
enough for me, and yet."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...After I finished running, I felt like I 
could do something even more amazing.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"I wanna keep running more and more...! 
There's no way in hell I can let it end 
here...!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I... I don't want it to end 
yet...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
My resolve tends to flip-flop all over the 
place, so you might not trust me, but...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I wanna run in an awesome race like the 
Satsuki Sho again...!! I wanna become even 
bigger...!!
choice_data_list:
...Well then, I need to make sure I heal 
up properly.

...Well then, I need to make sure I heal 
up properly, okay?

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"...Then at least give me six months and 
two weeks. Let us do everything we can 
with the goal of a full recovery by then."

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
In other words, absolute rest until 
November. If you are to enter a race, you 
must always report to me and let me 
inspect your hooves.

November means it will take place after 
the remaining Triple Crown legs, the 
"Japanese Derby" and "Kikuka Sho," have 
already passed.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
......I might not be able to run in the 
Derby or the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Yes. When checking the condition of the 
hooves before the race, the doctor might 
call for a medical stoppage.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"However, that is an absolute condition 
for my cooperation. ...You do want to keep 
running, don't you?"

"And after the two of us listened to the 
doctor's plan for future treatment, we 
left the hospital."

—A few days later. With the "Satsuki Sho" 
over, Tosen Jordan was scheduled for her 
first hospital visit this weekend.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Yo, Jordan's Trainer. You seem pretty 
good at setting up plays, huh."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Thanks to that, the public's hype 
for the Triple Crown route is simmering up 
like crazy. Everyone's looking for "the 
next Jordan."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
As a player myself, I'm looking forward to 
it. ...To the raging current you guys are 
going to create.
(Rumble rumble rumble!)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, something bad is going on! What 
does this mean?!

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Jordan-san! Jordan! Jordan!!

Following right behind a panting Tosen 
Jordan, a group of unfamiliar Umamusume 
came rushing in.

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"No way, look at Jordan in that article! 
She looks insane! Come on, you gotta tell 
me all about it!"

What they showed me on their smartphone 
was an online article.

"Tosen Jordan's Glory: A Victory Seized 
Beyond Hardship"

There was an article about Tosen Jordan, 
accompanied by a photo of her running 
covered in mud before the Satsuki Sho.

Struggling with hoof treatment, she kept 
training to seize her dream and ran with 
everything she had in the Satsuki Sho. 
Though being rushed to the hospital before 
the Winning Live shocked the crowd—

—When she returned afterwards, she wore a 
determined smile. I felt certain that she 
would go on to run many more magnificent 
races...

At the end of the article purely cheering 
for Tosen Jordan... was the name of the 
reporter who had come to interview her 
before the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"I heard rumors about Jordan before, 
y'know. Like how she's always skipping 
team tryouts, or how there's no way she'd 
win the Triple Crown—just all kinds of 
crazy talk."

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
I thought you were like us... Like, maybe 
idiots just... act that way? That's what I 
figured, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume D
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*... But when I saw that article, 
Jordan wasn't chickening out. She hadn't 
given up...

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume E
text_block_list.text:
Even though your hoof hurt... During the 
Satsuki Sho, you were totally decked out, 
looking so cute... and so cool...

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, she's like... a shining star 
among gals...!
choice_data_list: Looks like everyone looks up to you.
Looks like everyone looks up to you.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh? For me?

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: (*Nod nod nod nod!*)

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I mean, she's got crazy guts!! Isn't that 
so cool...!!

The gathered Umamusume nodded in unison. 
To which, Tosen Jordan—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...Ha, haha! What the heck! You should've 
just told me sooner!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Being chased by someone in tears was 
pretty terrifying~. Seriously~.

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... But we...! We absolutely, totally 
promised to cheer for Jordan in her next 
race...!

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
If you've decided which race you're 
entering, I'd really like you to tell 
me~...!

The doctor told me to focus on basic 
treatment until November. Depending on the 
circumstances, I could still race, but...

...For now, a race from November onward. 
One that fits her aptitude and makes for a 
good target would be—
choice_data_list: Maybe around the Copa Republica Argentina?

text_block_list.text:
A 2500m turf GⅡ race held in November. 
Many Umamusume use this race as a stepping 
stone toward the GⅠs.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Country... as in another country? Am I 
going overseas?!

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: Huh? What does that even mean...?

International exchange races are held as 
part of goodwill efforts. Similar races 
are prepared in the host countries as 
well—

text_block_list.name: Jordan and the Others
choice_data_list:
...Well, it's a pretty amazing race in its 
own right!

...Well, it's a pretty amazing race in its 
own right!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: "Huh~! Is that so~?"

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusumes
text_block_list.text:
Awesome! As expected of a race Jordan is 
running in!!

I feel like I've gained another 
high-maintenance student, but first... 
let's focus on treating her hoof before 
the Copa Republica Argentina.
